_note: Built-in clinical preset. Enable with VAYL_SLOT_SCHEMA=preset:clinical and VAYL_CRITICAL_CATEGORIES=critical so allergies/meds are always injected. Medications are confirm "auto": a clear start, stop, switch or dose change applies at once (marked auto-applied in history), and only an uncertain one (hedged, negated, future-tense, low confidence, or one that would leave two anticoagulants active) waits for approval. Code status is "review": every change waits for a clinician. Allergies are not gated: surfacing a new allergy is safety-positive and must be immediate. Set VAYL_CONFIRM_MODE=review to require approval for every medication change.
